requirements.text: Provide four waiting entries plus one separately stored active request. Keep blocked candidates stable through stalls and newly pending refresh.

Drain active work and cleanup, PRE remaining open banks in ascending order, respect all-bank tRP, commit REF once, and exclude commands strictly before REF-edge+tRFC. Retain queued traffic and resume service afterward.

    - R8

requirements.text: Explicitly distinguish initial command candidate creation from replacement. Dispatch captures the request without forming a candidate on that edge. When the candidate slot is empty, form the first candidate on a later edge from registered ownership and current bank state. Hold a blocked candidate unchanged. Commit clears its slot; a following candidate is formed only on a later edge using updated bank state, never by same-edge replacement. Reset wins; an outstanding candidate holds or commits before other progress. With no candidate, drain active service, then cleanup, then pending refresh preparation. Refresh service blocks dispatch and new candidate formation. Internal state encoding remains an implementation choice.

      repeat with cleanup reserved and with refresh pending.
    expected: Dispatch creates no candidate; blocked candidates hold; commit clears
      the slot; later creation uses updated state; active, cleanup, and refresh-preparation
      candidates follow the declared priority; pending refresh inhibits dispatch and
      candidates never replace on the commit edge.
    status: planned_not_executed
    rules:
    - BASE_SEQUENCE
    - R12
    - SYS_CONTROL_PRIORITY

requirements.text: Define payload behavior independently of valid gating. candidate_command is canonical zero NOP when candidate_valid is low. commit_command mirrors candidate_command even when candidate_ok is low; permission gates commit_valid only, and consumers sample payload only on commit_valid. probe_command remains the combinational first-command query from the incoming request and bank state even when probe_valid is low; idle, cleanup and refresh restrictions gate probe validity/readiness, not its payload. Reset forces all command payloads to zero NOP. Combinational dependencies must include any current-cycle input used to gate payload, not just its valid signal.
